title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Coincidence that Nightengale had an open sit-down in the Fenway stands with him a little while ago? Nightengale saying the Tigers were selling that night in Tampa in ‘15

Remember what I said that one night with you and Schmehl at that lobby bar at the Nashville winter meetings: He’s a Gangsta....knows what point to jump off. Now, he’ll go get his third ring somewhere else
Maybe he’ll go somewhere and bring you with him as an AGM
Once the Dan Shaunassey article came out a month ago I figured it was possible.
